grid.current_magnitude_basis: Twin design I_rms selected by em_fia_front_kit_case.
grid.default_campaign: 7 current angles × 5 rotor positions = 35 loaded FEMM points
grid.excitation_tracking: phase excitation angle = rotor-relative commanded current angle + 4 pole-pairs × rotor mechanical position
grid.fast_campaign: 2 current angles × 2 rotor positions = 4 loaded FEMM points

mtpa_screen.note: Comparative denser SCREEN only. This is not an optimisation-grade MTPA schedule and cannot close torque_map.
mtpa_screen.selection_metric: largest mean |weighted-stress torque| across sampled rotor positions at one design current magnitude

release_statement: SCREEN evidence only. No FIA homologation, team interface close, dynamometer correlation, race evidence, or permission to ship.

torque_map.reason: One-current-magnitude current-angle × rotor-position screen does not cover speed/voltage, current magnitude, losses, temperature, demagnetisation, field weakening, mesh convergence, or dynamometer correlation.
